signIn.title: Platform owner sign-in
signIn.passwordSaved: Your new password is saved. Sign in with it.

code.title: Enter the code from your authenticator app
code.label: 6-digit code from your authenticator app
code.hint: Each code works once. If it was just used, wait for the next one.
code.useApp: Use the code from the app instead
code.recoveryHint: One of the 16-character codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in. Each works once.

device.title: New-device check
device.body: This device is new. We sent one code by SMS and one code by email. Enter both.

enrol.title: Set up two-step sign-in
enrol.body: Before you set up two-step sign-in, we sent one code by SMS and one code by email. Enter both.

errors.generic: Sign-in did not work. Check what you typed and try again.
errors.identifierRequired: Enter your email or phone number.
errors.wrongCode: Code did not match, use the new 30-second code.
errors.wrongDeviceCode: A code did not match. Check both codes and try again.
errors.slowDown: Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter your email. If it belongs to an owner, we send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email belongs to an owner, a link to set a new password is on its way.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.body: Choose a new password. You will sign in with it on the next page.
reset.badLinkBody: It may be old or already used. Ask for a new one.

errors.generic: The password could not be saved. Try again.

whyTwoSteps.title: Why two steps?
whyTwoSteps.body: A password alone can be stolen. The second step is a code only your phone can make, so a thief with your password still cannot get in.

whatIsRecoveryCode.title: What is a recovery code?
whatIsRecoveryCode.body: When you turned on two-step sign-in you saved ten spare codes. If you lose your phone, type one of them instead of the app code. Each works only once.
